description: What the Plan screen does to a plan — **a list of entries in one call**. Per entry: `plan_id` for an existing plan, or `create: true` with `name` (and `copy_of`, a plan id, to start from its sizes and its choices for the bills); then any of `name`, `make_default`, `basis` ({kind: LAST_PAYCHECK | AVERAGE_LAST_N | SPECIFIC_PAYCHECK | CUSTOM_AMOUNT, amount, months, paycheck_id}) — a bonus month is a plan whose basis is an amount — and `buckets`, **the plan’s whole list of buckets** as the screen’s bar has it: each {bucket_id (existing) or name (new), points_at: {kind: goal | debt | category | fund | account | none, id}, mode: percent | amount | rest, percent (0-100), amount (major units), locked}. A bucket is for one thing, and a bucket sized “rest” takes what is left after the others and the bills that are part of the split; at most one. Or, alone, `delete: true` (the default plan too; another becomes the default), or `remove_buckets` to take buckets out and hand each share to its right. What each bill does to a plan is `set_fixed_expense_roles`. **Dry-runs by default**; `commit: true` writes. The document is copied to a timestamped .bak first. Ids come from `plans`.

commit.description: Default false. False previews; true writes.

path.description: Absolute path to a .emd file on this machine.

plans.description: One entry per plan. Up to 100 in a call.

amount.description: Major units a month, for mode amount.

locked.description: A divider will not move it.

name.description: A new bucket’s name, or a new name for an existing one.

id.description: The goal, debt, category, fund or account, by id or by name.

copy_of.description: With `create`: a plan id to copy the sizes and choices from.

create.description: Make a new plan instead. Needs `name`.

delete.description: Delete the plan. Alone in the entry. Deleting the default makes the next plan the default.

make_default.description: Make this the plan the screen opens on.

name.description: A name. Another plan’s name is refused.

remove_buckets.description: Bucket ids to take out of this plan. Each one’s share goes to the bucket on its right (in that bucket’s own unit), or to the money not given a job if it was last. A bucket no other plan uses is deleted. Applied before any `buckets` list in the same entry.

name: set_plan
title: Create, change or delete plans
